sentences.en: OFFICIAL: Hello, Tourist Information Centre, Mike speaking, how can I help you?
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL: 您好，这里是旅游信息中心，我是迈克，请问有什么可以帮您的？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Oh, hi.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 哦，你好。

sentences.en: I wanted to find out about cookery classes.
sentences.zh: 我想了解一下烹饪课程的情况。

sentences.en: I believe there are some one-day classes for tourists?
sentences.zh: 我听说有一些面向游客的一日制课程？

sentences.en: OFFICIAL: Well, they're open to everyone, but tourists are always welcome.
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL: 嗯，这些课程对所有人开放，不过游客当然也欢迎。

sentences.en: OK, let me give you some details of what's available.
sentences.zh: 好的，我来为您介绍一下目前有哪些课程可供选择。

sentences.en: There are several classes.
sentences.zh: 目前有几类课程。

sentences.en: One very popular one is at the Food Studio.
sentences.zh: 其中非常受欢迎的一类是在“美食工作室”开设的。

sentences.en: Example
sentences.zh: 示例

sentences.en: WOMAN: OK.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的。

sentences.en: OFFICIAL: They focus on seasonal products, and as well as teaching you to how to cook them, they also show you how to choose them.
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL: 他们注重使用应季食材，除了教您如何烹制这些食材外，还会教您如何挑选它们。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Right, that sounds good.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的，听起来不错。

sentences.en: How big are the classes?
sentences.zh: 每班人数有多少？

sentences.en: OFFICIAL.
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL:

sentences.en: I'm not sure exactly, but they'll be quite small.
sentences.zh: 我不太确定具体人数，但班级规模会比较小。

sentences.en: WOMAN: And could get a private lesson there?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那里能提供一对一授课吗？

sentences.en: OFFICIAL: think so ... let me check, yes, they do offer those.
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL: 我想可以……让我查一下，是的，他们确实提供此类课程。

sentences.en: Though in fact most of the people who attend the classes find it's a nice way of getting to know one another.
sentences.zh: 不过实际上，大多数参加课程的人发现，这种方式很有利于彼此结识。

sentences.en: WOMAN: I suppose it must be, yes.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我想确实如此，是的。

sentences.en: OFFICIAL: And this company has a special deal for clients where they offer a discount of 20 percent if you return for a further class.
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL: 而且这家机构为顾客提供特别优惠：若您再次报名参加另一门课程，可享受八折优惠。

sentences.en: WOMAN: OK.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的。

sentences.en: But you said there were several classes?
sentences.zh: 但您刚才说有好几类课程？

sentences.en: OFFICIAL: That's right.
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL: 没错。

sentences.en: Another one you might be interested in is Bond's Cookery School.
sentences.zh: 另一家您可能感兴趣的机构是邦德烹饪学校。

sentences.en: They're quite new, they just opened six months ago, but I've heard good things about them.
sentences.zh: 他们成立时间不长，仅在六个月前刚开业，但我已听到不少关于他们的正面评价。

sentences.en: They concentrate on teaching you to prepare healthy food, and to they have quite a lot of specialist staff.
sentences.zh: 他们专注于教授健康食品的制作方法，并拥有多位专业师资。

sentences.en: WOMAN: So is that food for people on a diet and things like that?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那么，这类食品是否专为节食人群之类的人群设计？

sentences.en: I don't know if I'd be interested in that.
sentences.zh: 我不确定自己是否会对这类课程感兴趣。

sentences.en: OFFICIAL.
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL:

sentences.en: Well, I don't think they particularly focus on low calorie diets or weight loss.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为他们并不特别侧重于低热量饮食或减重方案。

sentences.en: It's more to do with recipes that look at specific needs. like including ingredients that will help build up your bones and make them stronger, that sort of thing.
sentences.zh: 其重点更多在于针对特定健康需求的食谱，例如加入有助于强健骨骼、增强骨密度的食材等。

sentences.en: WOMAN: see.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 明白了。

sentences.en: Well, I might be interested, I'm not sure.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我或许会感兴趣，但还不太确定。

sentences.en: Do they have a website I could check?
sentences.zh: 他们有官网可以查询吗？

sentences.en: OFFICIAL: Yes, just key in the name of the school - it'll come up.
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL: 有，只需在搜索引擎中输入该校名称——就能找到。

sentences.en: And if you want to know more about them, every Thursday evening they have a lecture at the school.
sentences.zh: 另外，若您想进一步了解他们，每周四晚上该校都会举办一场讲座。

sentences.en: It's free and you don't need to book or anything, just turn up at 7.30.
sentences.zh: 讲座免费，无需预约，您只需在晚上7:30直接到场即可。

sentences.en: And that might give you an idea of whether you want to go to an actual class.
sentences.zh: 这或许能帮助您判断是否真想报名参加正式课程。

sentences.en: OFFICIAL: OK, there's one more place you might be interested in.
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL: 好的，还有一处地方您或许也会感兴趣。

sentences.en: That's got a rather strange name, it's called The Arretsa Centre - that's spelled A-R-R-E-T-S-A.
sentences.zh: 它的名字有点特别，叫‘阿雷萨中心’——拼写为A-R-R-E-T-S-A。

sentences.en: WOMAN: OK.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的。

sentences.en: OFFICIAL: They've got a very good reputation.
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL: 他们的声誉非常好。

sentences.en: They a do a bit of meat and fish cookery but they mostly specialise in vegetarian dishes.
sentences.zh: 他们也做一些肉类和鱼类烹饪，但主要专精于素食菜肴。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Right.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的。

sentences.en: That's certainly an area I'd like to learn more about.
sentences.zh: 这确实是我很想多学习的一个领域。

sentences.en: I've got lots of friends who don't eat meat.
sentences.zh: 我有很多朋友不吃肉。

sentences.en: In fact, I think might have seen that school today.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我想我今天可能已经见过那所学校了。

sentences.en: Is it just by the market?
sentences.zh: 它就在市场旁边吗？

sentences.en: Audioscripts
sentences.zh: 听力原文

sentences.en: OFFICIAL: That's right.
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL: 没错。

sentences.en: So they don't have any problem getting their ingredients.
sentences.zh: 因此他们在获取食材方面没有任何问题。

sentences.en: They're right next door.
sentences.zh: 它们就紧挨着。

sentences.en: And they also offer special two-hour course in how to use t knife.
sentences.zh: 此外，他们还提供专门的两小时课程，教如何使用刀具。

sentences.en: They cover all the different skills - buying them, sharpening, chopping techniques.
sentences.zh: 课程涵盖所有相关技能——包括选购刀具、磨刀以及切菜技巧。

sentences.en: It gets booked up quickly though so you'd need to check it was available.
sentences.zh: 不过这个课程很快就会被预订满，所以你需要先确认是否有空位。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Right, well thank you very much.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的，非常感谢您。

sentences.en: I'll go and
sentences.zh: 我这就去
